_source: The barriers a duty's director takes down with a map effect (DirectorMapEffect: index, timeline, state), by territory: for each map effect index (where its SharedGroup stands in the duty's ContentDirectorManagedSG, the list DirectorSetupMapEffects follows), the [timeline, state] that takes it down. kawari-navimesh makes those SharedGroups gimmicks (left out of the navmesh, in the collision by their layout ID); the server seals them as the duty begins (nobody walks through, as no player can) and takes them out of the collision when the director sends that map effect. Castrum Meridianum (1043): the packs whose fall opens the way send 0, 1, 5 and 6 with timeline 2, state 1 (five retail runs: w1d4_re.lua's PACKS); 1 is the way into the first boss's room at (36.0, 72.0, -46.2), which stayed in the collision for everyone after it opened (Bob's marks of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21: the Player NPCs couldn't get into the Black Eft's room). An index whose SharedGroup has no collision changes nothing.
